title: Network Standing of a Line Put Right and the Benefit Basis Taken
content:
Where a line under one of the Optional Supplemental Benefit Riders is put right, whether the provider who gave it stood inside or outside the rider's network settles the benefit basis taken.

## The rule

1. Where the line put right was given by a provider outside the network and the rider held carries an out-of-network share above nil, the benefit basis is that share of the allowed amount the line carries.
2. Where the line put right was given by a provider outside the network and the rider held carries no out-of-network share, nothing is taken as the benefit basis.
3. Otherwise, the line having been given by a provider inside the network, the benefit basis is the whole of the allowed amount the line carries.

## The out-of-network share each rider carries

| Rider | Out-of-network share (per cent) |
|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider | 0 |
| Ridgecrest Vision Plus Rider | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Hearing Advantage Rider | 50 |
| Ridgecrest Comprehensive Dental Rider | 60 |
| Ridgecrest Premier Dental Rider | 70 |
| Ridgecrest Dental Vision Hearing Bundle Rider | 70 |

Only the Ridgecrest Preventive Dental Rider, carrying 0, carries no out-of-network share; on the remaining five the share stands above nil.

## Positive and negative cases, on hypothetical inputs

Take a line put right whose allowed amount is 600.00 USD.

- **Given inside the network:** the benefit basis is the whole 600.00 USD.
- **Given outside the network, the rider carrying 50 per cent:** the benefit basis is 300.00 USD.
- **Given outside the network, the rider carrying 70 per cent:** the benefit basis is 420.00 USD.
- **Given outside the network, the rider carrying 0:** nothing is taken as the benefit basis.

The benefit basis is rounded to the nearest cent.
